sources.title: IDEALLab/engiopt-neurips-diffusion-2d-cond · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: These are NOT comparable to current EngiOpt checkpoints. The EngiBench problem definitions have changed since the paper, so a result here and a result in IDEALLab/engiopt-diffusion-2d-cond for the same problem id measure different things.

sources.title: IDEALLab/engiopt-public-smoke-cgan-cnn-2d · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: EngiOpt cgan_cnn_2d This repository stores EngiOpt checkpoint packages for one model family. Each checkpoint package contains model weight files together with run_config.json and metadata.json so evaluation can run without depending on W&B run config state.
